name: Pterodactyl Panel
description: Web panel for creating and managing game servers across one or more Wings nodes.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      APP_ENV: production
      CACHE_DRIVER: redis
      SESSION_DRIVER: redis
      QUEUE_CONNECTION: redis
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_DATABASE: panel
      DB_USERNAME: pterodactyl
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      REDIS_PORT: 6379
      APP_URL: {{env.APP_URL}}
      MAIL_FROM: {{env.MAIL_FROM}}
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/var:/app/var
      - {{appDataPath}}/nginx:/etc/nginx/http.d
      - {{appDataPath}}/certs:/etc/letsencrypt
      - {{appDataPath}}/logs:/app/storage/logs
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: panel
      MYSQL_USER: pterodactyl
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
